def _strip_attrs(attrs, predicate, finditer, value_fn):
    out = []
    pos = 0
    for am in finditer(attrs):
        an = am.group(1).lower()
        av = value_fn(am)
        if predicate(an, av):
            out.append(attrs[pos:am.start()])
            end = am.end()
            import re
            m = re.match(r"\s+", attrs[end:])
            if m:
                end += m.end()
            pos = end
        else:
            pos = am.end()
    out.append(attrs[pos:])
    return "".join(out)
